title: Layout techniques / Some stories start small

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Let type, illustration and imagery each carry part of a message so the composition invites exploration without losing its reading order.
strategic_value: A recurring phrase and glyph can connect playful Instagram compositions across formats.
demonstration: Large separated words and two stickers occupy the white left half; a portrait, white glyph and Meta signature occupy the right.
practical_value: Use whitespace and the line sequence to keep scattered elements readable.

content_islands.name: Words and stickers
content_islands.spec: Distribute the sentence vertically through the white left panel, with small in gradient near the bottom.

content_islands.name: Portrait signature
content_islands.spec: Fill the right panel with the portrait and center the glyph over it, keeping the parent signature below.

reference_purposes.Expression: Loose words, stickers and portrait show a playful compositional voice.
reference_purposes.Application: The split layout demonstrates how those elements combine in a campaign.
